title: Panormos (Küdür)
description: A narrow, long bay opening on the north side of the modern Küdür peninsula in the Bodrum district of Turkey's Muğla province. BAtlDir offers the modern name "Alaman Gölü".

properties.description: Imagery location, determined in Google Earth, with reference to "PANORMOS" label and arrow in BAtlas 61 E3. Dates after BAtlDir.
